summary: This House Resolution expresses the sense that the U.S. Department of Agriculture should use its contingency funds and interchange authority to finance the Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP) in November 2025, asserting the administration's legal obligation and authority to do so for the well-being of families experiencing hunger.

scores.thoughts: This resolution expresses the sense of the House that the USDA should use existing contingency funds and interchange authority to finance SNAP. It does not propose new spending but rather directs the use of already appropriated funds, thus it has a neutral impact on overall government spending levels.

The resolution is entirely focused on ensuring the continued funding and operation of the Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP), which is a core component of the social safety net. By urging the administration to use available funds to prevent a lapse in SNAP benefits, it strongly advocates for maintaining and effectively delivering welfare services.
